title: My account
languageIntro: The language the pages are shown in. If you choose “Same as the call centre”, you follow the call centre's language.
passkeysIntro: With a passkey you log in with Face ID, Touch ID, Windows Hello or a security key. It gives the same access as BankID, with no cost per login.
nameHint: For example the device it is on.
added: The passkey has been added. Next time you can log in with it.
needBankId: To add a passkey you must be logged in with BankID. Log out and log in again with BankID, then you can add it here.
